topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The topic or niche you make videos about, written the way a viewer would search for it.

maxVideos.title: Videos to study
maxVideos.description: How many top videos the agent reads the opening of. More videos give a richer brief and a longer run.

modelName.title: Model
modelName.description: OpenRouter model slug (see https://openrouter.ai/models). The model is called through the Apify OpenRouter proxy, so no provider API key is needed.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: If enabled, the full tool results are written to the log.
